name: View Count
description: Counts visitors' views of published content, by country if you choose, for the administration and, if you choose, shows them on content pages.
author: HaxePress

fields.label: Show the view count on content pages
fields.help: Visitors then see how many times the content was viewed. Counts are updated once a minute.

fields.label: Count views by country
fields.help: Countries come from the Cloudflare plugin. Views without a country from Cloudflare are counted as UNKNOWN.
